##########################################################################
# Eire Reborn - Update 8 (Irish activities) triggers, generated by tools/gen_activities.py
##########################################################################

# A ruler of the Gaelic or Brythonic stock.
eir_act_gael_host_trigger = {
	is_playable_character = yes
	highest_held_title_tier > tier_barony
	culture ?= {
		OR = {
			has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic
			has_cultural_pillar = heritage_brythonic
		}
	}
}

# The High King's feast: an Irish king with land in Ireland.
eir_act_feis_host_trigger = {
	is_playable_character = yes
	highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom
	culture ?= { has_cultural_pillar = heritage_goidelic }
	any_sub_realm_county = {
		kingdom = title:k_ireland
	}
}

# The pilgrimage: any Gaelic or Brythonic ruler whose faith values it (Christian, or any faith with the tenet), landed.
eir_act_pilgrim_host_trigger = {
	eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
	faith = { religion = religion:christianity_religion }
}

# The bardic contest: any Gaelic or Brythonic ruler with a court.
eir_act_bardic_host_trigger = {
	eir_act_gael_host_trigger = yes
	is_ruler = yes
}
